تستثمري (form X)
# تَسْتَثْمِرِي (tastaṯmirī) /tas.taθ.mi.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَثْمَرَ (istaṯmara)
# تُسْتَثْمَرِي (tustaṯmarī) /tus.taθ.ma.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَثْمَرَ (istaṯmara)
